name: powerautomate-copilot
description: Give GitHub Copilot native tools to build, debug, and manage Power Automate flows — entirely locally, no third-party server.

powerAutomate.clientId.description: Azure AD Application (client) ID. Leave blank to use the shared client ID. Provide your own for enterprise/sovereign cloud scenarios.

powerAutomate.apiBaseUrl.description: Power Automate API base URL. Change for sovereign cloud environments.

powerAutomate.confirmDestructiveActions.description: Require confirmation before updating or deleting live flows.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_listEnvironments
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all Power Automate environments accessible to the signed-in user. Call this first to discover available environments before working with flows.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_listConnections
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all connections available in the active (or specified) Power Automate environment.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_listFlows
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all flows in the active (or specified) Power Automate environment, including their enabled/disabled state.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_getFlow
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the full definition (JSON) of a specific flow. Use this to inspect a flow's triggers, actions, and configuration.

flowName.description: Flow name/ID. If omitted, uses the active flow.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_getFlowRuns
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the run history of a flow, including status (Succeeded/Failed/Running/Cancelled) and start/end times. Use this to identify recent failures.

flowName.description: Flow name/ID. If omitted, uses the active flow.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

top.description: Maximum number of runs to return (default: 10).

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_getFlowRunError
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets per-action error details for a specific failed flow run. Use this after identifying a failed run with getFlowRuns to understand exactly which action failed and why.

flowName.description: Flow name/ID. If omitted, uses the active flow.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_getFlowRunActionOutputs
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspects the inputs and outputs of a specific action within a flow run. Useful for debugging data transformation issues.

actionName.description: The action name within the run.

flowName.description: Flow name/ID. If omitted, uses the active flow.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_getFlowHttpSchema
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the HTTP trigger request and response schema for a flow. Use this before triggering a flow to know what payload to send.

flowName.description: Flow name/ID. If omitted, uses the active flow.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_getFlowTriggerUrl
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the signed callback URL for an HTTP-triggered flow. The URL includes an auth signature and can be used to trigger the flow directly.

flowName.description: Flow name/ID. If omitted, uses the active flow.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_updateFlow
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new flow or updates an existing flow definition. Provide the full flow JSON. The user will be asked to confirm before any update is applied to a live flow.

flowDefinition.description: The full Power Automate flow definition JSON.

flowName.description: Flow name/ID to update. Omit to create a new flow.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_setFlowState
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Enables or disables a flow. Use this to turn a flow on or off without modifying its definition.

state.description: The desired state of the flow.

flowName.description: Flow name/ID. If omitted, uses the active flow.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_addFlowToSolution
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Migrates a flow into a Power Platform solution. Solutions are required for ALM/deployment pipelines.

solutionId.description: The solution unique name or ID to add the flow to.

flowName.description: Flow name/ID. If omitted, uses the active flow.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_triggerFlow
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fires an HTTP-triggered flow with an optional JSON payload. Use getFlowHttpSchema first to know what payload the trigger expects.

body.description: Optional JSON payload to send to the HTTP trigger.

flowName.description: Flow name/ID. If omitted, uses the active flow.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_resubmitFlowRun
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Resubmits a previously failed flow run with the same inputs. Use this after fixing the underlying issue to re-run without manually re-triggering.

flowName.description: Flow name/ID. If omitted, uses the active flow.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.

languageModelTools.name: powerAutomate_cancelFlowRun
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Cancels a flow run that is currently in progress.

flowName.description: Flow name/ID. If omitted, uses the active flow.

environmentName.description: Environment name/ID. If omitted, uses the active environment.
